reveal_en: Unlike most animals, octopuses don't just express the genes they inherit. They extensively edit their own RNA, the messenger molecules that translate DNA into proteins, allowing them to rapidly adapt to their environment without altering their core DNA.
reveal_zh: 与其他大多数动物不同，章鱼能广泛编辑信使RNA，将DNA信息转化为蛋白质。这使它们无需改变核心DNA即可快速适应环境。
meaning_en: This reveals an active and flexible layer of biological adaptation, suggesting life can evolve far more dynamically than just through genetic mutation.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了生物适应的灵活层级，暗示生命演化比单纯的基因突变更为动态。

visual.motion: Subtle, undulating flow, like deep ocean currents, with faint shimmering data streams.
